name: Beijing United Information Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Beijing United Information Technology Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the online commodity trading business in China. It operates through Coatings and Chemical Industry, Hygiene Products Industry, Glass Industry, Fertilizer Industry, Grain and Oil Industry, and Others segments. The company operates Guolian Resources Network, an industrial information service platform that provides commercial information services to enterprises in various industries; Toodudu, Wdoodoo, Boododo, Zdoodoo, Feidoodoo, Lydodo, Xdoodoo, Yidoodoo, Lenglianduoduo, and Nedoodoo industrial e-commerce platforms, which provides online commodity trading services for upstream and downstream industries, …
